definitions.explanation: with breakfast included; breakfast included (as part of a hotel or accommodation package)

examples.japanese: {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}きプランで{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made a reservation with a breakfast-included plan.

examples.japanese: この{料金|りょうきん}は{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}きですか。
{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}きのホテルを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a hotel with breakfast included.

notes:
{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き is a common expression in travel and accommodation contexts, combining {朝食|ちょうしょく} (breakfast) + {付|つ}き (attached/included).

ACCOMMODATION TERMS:
- {素泊|すどま}り (room only, no meals)
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き (with breakfast)
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き (with dinner)
- {二食付|にしょくつ}き (with two meals - breakfast and dinner)
- {一泊二食|いっぱくにしょく} (one night with two meals)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}きプラン (breakfast-included plan)
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き{宿泊|しゅくはく} (accommodation with breakfast)

BREAKFAST OPTIONS:
- {和食|わしょく} (Japanese breakfast)
- {洋食|ようしょく} (Western breakfast)
- バイキング/ビュッフェ (buffet)

RELATED ～{付|つ}き EXPRESSIONS:
- {駐車場付|ちゅうしゃじょうつ}き (with parking)
- {送迎付|そうげいつ}き (with transfer service)
- {税込|ぜいこ}み/{税|ぜい}{込|こ}み (tax included)

REGISTER: Neutral. Standard travel/hotel vocabulary.
